name: 05089 · Windsor, VT
findings: ZIP 05089 (Windsor) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 05089 (Windsor) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
